name: gemini-advisor
description: A Gemini advisor the model calls by itself: Gemini reads the conversation and the model's message and answers with a second opinion. /gemini-advisor turns it on or off; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level. Needs function hooks (early access).

maxInputChars.title: Maximum characters sent to Gemini
maxInputChars.description: Above it the longest tool outputs of the conversation are cut to their head and tail before sending.

maxOutputTokens.title: Maximum advice tokens
maxOutputTokens.description: The longest advice Gemini may write, thinking included.
